assumptions: Clusters are separable on the chosen channels after the display transform.
limits: One file per call; the map is rebuilt each call (no FlowSOM model reuse across files).
bio.jane/contract.question: Which cell populations does FlowSOM find in this file, and how large is each?

description: FlowSOM on an FCS file's population: a self-organizing map of the chosen channels (fluorescence on the display scale), its nodes joined by their minimum spanning tree, grouped into metaclusters by ConsensusClusterPlus, with per-node marker medians, shares of events and FlowSOM's TestOutliers report.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

channels.description: channels to build the map on, comma-separated; empty for every fluorescence channel.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

seed.description: R set.seed for the map and the metaclustering.

standardize.description: FlowSOM scale = TRUE: center and divide each channel by its SD first.

name: cluster_flow_cytometry_flowsom

mst.description: the minimum spanning tree: node pairs and normalized weights

nodes.description: per node: metacluster, share of events, median per map channel

outliers.description: per node: events, outliers, distance threshold, maximum distance
